description: Establish the frozen v1 compatibility rail and implement the strict v2 privacy/trust contract: finite canonical input grammar, source allowlist, HMAC token separation, RFC-8785-style attestation, key registry, and consent/participation model primitives. This is the prerequisite for every v2 runtime and API feature.
steps: Copy the current v1 scorer/motif boundary into backend/app/evaluation/v1_compat.py and backend/app/evaluation/v1_motifs.py, route only the existing --days evaluator through it, and add backend/tests/fixtures/earlytrace-v1-seed7.json plus backend/tests/test_v1_compatibility.py so the seed-7/days-24 command remains immutable and explicitly labelled v1 compatibility.

Extend backend/app/models/preauth.py with strict v2 event/decision/action/feedback contracts, fixed enums and registries, exact regexes, ConsentOutcome and Participation, stable UNKNOWN consistency, and the unsupported-schema safe envelope; add backend/app/security/input_boundary.py to reject duplicate keys, canonical-key collisions, finite forbidden aliases, over-depth/over-token JSON, and raw values before Pydantic/logging.

Add backend/app/security/canonical_json.py and backend/app/security/preauth_attestation.py implementing RFC-8785-style canonical UTF-8 JSON, SHA-256 safe-envelope digests, Ed25519 unpadded base64url signatures, server-side payload reconstruction, and injected-clock key registry active/expiry/revocation checks.

Split backend/app/security/tokens.py into tok_ live tokens, case_ display pseudonyms, and isolated legacy/fixture grammars with an immediate-HMAC TrustedReferenceAdapter; add the EventSource allowlist and source/key/consent primitives in backend/app/context/preauth.py without enabling external connectors.
Update focused model/input/token/attestation tests and the scope/data documents without treating any v2 control as implemented until tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: The HTTP-safe v2 grammar accepts only tok_[0-9a-f]{32} live tokens and rejects acct_, acc_, raw references, exact sensitive values, duplicate/colliding keys, forbidden aliases, unknown fields, and validation-error echoing.
EventSource accepts only SYNTHETIC_GENERATOR, SANDBOX_FIXTURE, and STAGING_REGISTERED_FIXTURE; EXTERNAL_BANK, BANK, NPCI, UPI_SWITCH, CLOUD, and unknown values are rejected.

Attestation and consent mutation tests fail before graph/context mutation and use server-reconstructed canonical payloads, SHA-256 digests, Ed25519 base64url signatures, active/expiry/revocation registry state, and an injected clock.
The legacy seed-7/days-24 evaluator still passes its stable descriptor and is labelled v1 compatibility; v1 is not exposed as a public scoring contract.
